challenge.method: Tested a 1.2-only notice designating a single two-word Front-Cover Text and zero Invariant Sections, then removed the designation, withheld the notice, and separately added later-version wording.
challenge.results: The single listed passage meets the positive-feature condition. A complete notice declaring none falls outside it. An unavailable notice leaves both the feature and edition choices unproved. Adding later-version wording while retaining the passage changes the edition choice to invariants-or-later. Substituting a grant confined to 1.1 or 1.3 also defeats the exact 1.2-only mapping.

limitations: GNU's Addendum illustrates a later-version option. Section 1 places the grant in the copyright holder's notice. The sample cannot expand a hypothetical grant confined to 1.2. Preserve the actual notice separately from the unaltered license document.
